title: DOW-UAP-D7, Mission Report, Arabian Gulf, 2020
doc_notes: This document is a heavily redacted Mission Report (MISREP) from the Department of War regarding a 2020 UAP sighting in the Arabian Gulf.

incidents.summary: U.S. military operator observed a UAP at 31,000 ft traveling with the winds, identified via TFLIR.
incidents.quote: LOOKS LIKE A BALLOON, SIMILAR TO PREVIOUSLY REPORTED UAP FROM 48FW.
